title: Three named limits of the live-file rebuild (PR 3702), to fix before a session-rows reader is wired
why: Round 3 review (sonnet reviewer, net safety value zero) of PR 3702 left three open findings; a finding becomes a debt only after a real incident, and none can bite until a session-rows reader exists (owner page item 894), so they are named here, not debts. Read by the reviewer, not re-read by triage, 20:30 CST Nov 18.
source: round 3 review of PR 3702 at head eac3f97a23 (reviewer report 20:30 CST Nov 18)
